answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one tide weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The quartz report reveals the merge explicitly at each gale. Because of that, someone who spins up 177 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 236 times the capital for one share. A farm of 3283 identities would post 2658 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
